items.title: AI Chips Today - AI Tech Leaders Gather to Define Future Innovation
items.summary: The 1st Annual Tennessee C-Level Technology Leadership Summit, hosted by HMG Strategy, is set to take place in Nashville on November 13. This event will convene CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and senior technology executives from Tennessee and the surrounding regions to engage in discussions centered around artificial intelligence (AI), cybersecurity, and workforce transformation. The summit aims to foster a collaborative environment where technology leaders can share insights on how AI is redefining...

items.title: Premarket movers: Nvidia slides on Huang probe, NVR extends rally
items.summary: Investing.com -- Stock futures rose early Monday as traders watched technology shares following last week’s volatility, awaiting key inflation data and earnings from major AI companies. S&P 500 futures gained 0.5% and Nasdaq 100 futures rose about 0.3%. Dow Jones Industrial Average futures led, climbing 0.9%.
